predicates.vmulh: signed vs2 * signed other, high SEW bits
predicates.vmulhu: unsigned vs2 * unsigned other, high SEW bits
predicates.vmulhsu: signed vs2 * unsigned other, high SEW bits
predicates.vx: RV32 low SEW bits when SEW<=32; sign-extension when SEW=64, including unsigned operations
predicates.vdiv: abs(dividend)//abs(divisor), sign restored; no float; quotient modulo 2**SEW
predicates.signed_overflow: MIN/-1 yields MIN quotient, zero remainder

witness_coverage: 12 explicit arithmetic witnesses per multiply geometry/form; 13 per divide/remainder geometry/form, including additive 0/0. All inherited cases retained.
reference: Fixed executed Spike/pk zero-start and Sail0.14.1 nonzero-start packets; predicates supplement independent packets and never supply golden packets.
reserved: vstart>=VLMAX separately PROFILE_RESERVED_START under frozen accepting profile; no ordinary ISA PASS claim for that class
operand_limit: vx cannot express arbitrary SEW64 divisors: RV32 register operand is signed-extended. vv separately covers full SEW extrema.
state: All 32 vector registers, ten CSRs and scalar s0 pre/post. Legal agnostic values are checked as allowed sets.
scope: Finite cases, host512, six guest VLENs, ELEN64 profile, B/M1/M2/BOTH; no per-target method admission claim. No production edit.
encoding_note: multiply/divide use OPMVV=2 and OPMVX=6; funct6 0x20 through0x27. Actual ELF opcodes checked in every audit.
static_property_review: Original twelve witness tags occur in all132 geometries; added 0/0 tag likewise covers all132 divide geometries. Nonexceptional quotient/remainder reconstruction, magnitude and sign constraints checked.
zero_over_zero: Explicit numerator==divisor==0 covers a premature zero-numerator shortcut: all-one quotient, zero remainder. New separate units only; original fields and ordinals unchanged.
